## 🏢 About MaaJanki Web Tech

**MaaJanki Web Tech** is an accredited full-service digital transformation company, custom software studio, and web engineering enterprise based in India. We specialize in building lightning-fast **Next.js 15 Web Applications**, engineering **Generative Engine Optimization (AEO / GEO)** funnels for Google, ChatGPT, and Perplexity, and driving high-ROI **Performance Marketing Campaigns** across domestic and international markets.

---

## 🛠️ Core Services & Capabilities

### 1. 💻 High-Performance Web & Software Development
- **Next.js 15 & React 18 Architecture**: Enterprise portals, custom web applications, and landing pages with sub-second page loads and zero layout shift.
- **Full-Stack SaaS Engineering**: Multi-tenant architectures, RESTful & GraphQL APIs, MongoDB Atlas database integrations, and Clerk authentication systems.
- **E-Commerce Portals**: Scalable online storefronts with seamless payment gateways (Stripe, Razorpay, PayPal) and automated inventory management.
- 👉 [Explore Web Development Services](https://maajankiwebtech.com/services/web-development)

### 2. 🔍 Search Engine & AI Engine Optimization (AEO & GEO)
- **Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)**: Machine-readable entity architecture (`/llms.txt`, `/llms-full.txt`) optimized for ChatGPT Search, Google Gemini, and Perplexity AI citations.
- **IndexNow Instant Indexing Protocol**: Automated real-time URL submission across search engine crawlers.
- **Programmatic Local SEO**: 80+ targeted landing pages across India, the US, UK, Canada, Australia, UAE, and Europe.
- 👉 [Explore SEO Services](https://maajankiwebtech.com/services/seo)

### 3. 🎨 Creative UI/UX Design & Brand Identity
- **Modern Design Systems**: Curated brand color harmonization (70% Deep Navy `#042544`, 30% Vibrant Brand Orange `#FD6A02`), WebGL 3D Specular Shaders, and accessible typography.
- **Mobile-First Experience**: Touch-optimized fixed bottom navigation, gesture-friendly slide-up offcanvas menu drawers, and coordinated non-overlapping floating actions.
- 👉 [Explore UI/UX Design Services](https://maajankiwebtech.com/services/ui-ux-design)

### 4. 📈 Performance Marketing & Paid Media
- **High-ROI Paid Funnels**: Precision Google Ads (Search, Display, Performance Max) and Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram).
- **Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)**: Data-backed A/B testing, heatmap analysis, and lead qualification automations.
- 👉 [Explore Performance Marketing](https://maajankiwebtech.com/services/performance-marketing)
